hero.intro: NPTF Dryseal pipe fittings in brass, for air, water, fuel and low-pressure oil lines.

guidance.heading: NPTF or NPT
guidance.body: NPTF (Dryseal) threads are cut so the crests and roots close up as the joint is tightened, so they seal on the thread; they also mate with standard NPT threads, which rely on sealant or tape. Pick the body form, then the size on each end from the size table.

standards.heading: ASME B1.20.3 and B1.20.1
standards.body: Dryseal NPTF threads are defined by ASME B1.20.3 and NPT threads by ASME B1.20.1. The NPSM straight thread on the locknuts is also in B1.20.1 and does not seal on the thread.

hero.intro: British Standard Pipe and metric adapters in brass, for joining BSP and metric ports to NPT and JIC lines.

guidance.heading: BSPP or BSPT
guidance.body: BSPP (parallel) male studs seal on a bonded seal, washer or cone seat; BSPT (taper) threads seal on the flanks like NPT. The two share a pitch but do not interchange. Where a listing says BSP female without P or T, confirm the mating thread before ordering.

standards.heading: ISO 228-1 and ISO 7-1
standards.body: BSPP threads are defined by ISO 228-1 and BSPT threads by ISO 7-1. NPT ends follow ASME B1.20.1 and JIC ends SAE J514.

guidance.heading: How an inverted flare seals
guidance.body: The tube end is double flared at 45° and clamped inside the port by a male tube nut, so the seal sits inside the fitting and the threads are shielded. Use a double flare and a nut from the same system.

products.descriptionShort: Brass Air Brake × NPTF Male Connector for Nylon Tubing, in CA360 brass. 16 part numbers, 1/4" to 3/4" tube; the size table gives the size on each end for every Indus part number.
products.descriptionLong:
The Brass Air Brake × NPTF Male Connector for Nylon Tubing is a straight connector, in CA360 brass (C36000 free-machining brass). Its ends are air brake tube end (nylon tubing) and NPTF (Dryseal) male. Air brake fittings like this are made for truck and bus compressed-air brake systems plumbed with nylon tubing; the manufacturer states the range is DOT approved.

Construction

  • Body: straight connector
  • End 1: air brake tube end (nylon tubing)
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal) male
  • Material: CA360 brass (C36000 free-machining brass)

Ends and sealing

  • air brake tube end (nylon tubing): compression air brake joint for nylon tubing: the nut squeezes a brass sleeve onto the tube, and a brass tube insert supports the bore.
  • NPTF (Dryseal): Dryseal taper pipe thread, cut so the crests and roots close up as the joint is tightened, so it seals on the thread; ASME B1.20.3.

Sizes

16 part numbers, 1/4" to 3/4" tube. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists the size on each end for every one.

  • End 1: air brake tube end (nylon tubing), 1/4" to 3/4"
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal), 1/8" to 3/4" (1/8-27 to 3/4-14)

Pressure and service

The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for this family. Tell us the medium, working pressure and temperature, and we will confirm the fitting before you order.

For copper tubing

The matching fitting for copper air brake tubing: Brass Air Brake × NPTF Male Connector for Copper Tubing.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number from the size table. If you only have the fitting, send the size and thread type on each end, and Indus engineering will confirm the part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

products.title: Brass DOT Push-In Air Brake × NPTF Male 45° Elbow
products.focusKeyword: brass dot push-in to nptf male 45 elbow
products.descriptionShort: Brass DOT Push-In Air Brake × NPTF Male 45° Elbow, in C3600 / C3700 brass. 12 part numbers, 1/4" to 3/4" tube; the size table gives the size on each end for every Indus part number.
products.descriptionLong:
The Brass DOT Push-In Air Brake × NPTF Male 45° Elbow is a 45° elbow, in brass (C3600 / C3700 alloy, as the manufacturer states). Its ends are DOT push-in tube end and NPTF (Dryseal) male. DOT push-in fittings join nylon air brake tubing to SAE J844 without tools: the tube is cut square and pushed home. The manufacturer states compliance with FMVSS 571.106 and SAE J2494, and male pipe threads come with sealant already applied.

Construction

  • Body: 45° elbow
  • End 1: DOT push-in tube end
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal) male
  • Material: brass (C3600 / C3700 alloy, as the manufacturer states)

Ends and sealing

  • DOT push-in tube end: push-to-connect: the tube is pushed in, held by a gripping collet and sealed by an O-ring; SAE J2494.
  • NPTF (Dryseal): Dryseal taper pipe thread, cut so the crests and roots close up as the joint is tightened, so it seals on the thread; ASME B1.20.3.

Sizes

12 part numbers, 1/4" to 3/4" tube. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists the size on each end for every one.

  • End 1: DOT push-in tube end, 1/4" to 3/4"
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal), 1/8" to 1/2" (1/8-27 to 1/2-14)

Pressure and service

The manufacturer rates these fittings for compressed air only, no other gas or liquid, up to 150 psi, from −40 °F to +200 °F (−40 °C to +93 °C).

How to order

Quote the Indus part number from the size table. If you only have the fitting, send the size and thread type on each end, and Indus engineering will confirm the part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

products.focusKeyword: brass dot push-in to nptf female connector
products.descriptionShort: Brass DOT Push-In Air Brake × NPTF Female Connector, in C3600 / C3700 brass. 9 part numbers, 1/4" to 1/2" tube; the size table gives the size on each end for every Indus part number.
products.descriptionLong:
The Brass DOT Push-In Air Brake × NPTF Female Connector is a straight connector, in brass (C3600 / C3700 alloy, as the manufacturer states). Its ends are DOT push-in tube end and NPTF (Dryseal) female. DOT push-in fittings join nylon air brake tubing to SAE J844 without tools: the tube is cut square and pushed home. The manufacturer states compliance with FMVSS 571.106 and SAE J2494, and male pipe threads come with sealant already applied.

Construction

  • Body: straight connector
  • End 1: DOT push-in tube end
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal) female
  • Material: brass (C3600 / C3700 alloy, as the manufacturer states)

Ends and sealing

  • DOT push-in tube end: push-to-connect: the tube is pushed in, held by a gripping collet and sealed by an O-ring; SAE J2494.
  • NPTF (Dryseal): Dryseal taper pipe thread, cut so the crests and roots close up as the joint is tightened, so it seals on the thread; ASME B1.20.3.

Sizes

9 part numbers, 1/4" to 1/2" tube. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists the size on each end for every one.

  • End 1: DOT push-in tube end, 1/4" to 1/2"
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal), 1/8" to 1/2" (1/8-27 to 1/2-14)

Pressure and service

The manufacturer rates these fittings for compressed air only, no other gas or liquid, up to 150 psi, from −40 °F to +200 °F (−40 °C to +93 °C).

How to order

Quote the Indus part number from the size table. If you only have the fitting, send the size and thread type on each end, and Indus engineering will confirm the part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

products.descriptionLong:
The Brass DOT Push-In Air Brake × NPTF Male 45° Swivel Elbow is a 45° swivel elbow, in brass (C3600 / C3700 alloy, as the manufacturer states). Its ends are DOT push-in tube end and NPTF (Dryseal) male. DOT push-in fittings join nylon air brake tubing to SAE J844 without tools: the tube is cut square and pushed home. The manufacturer states compliance with FMVSS 571.106 and SAE J2494, and male pipe threads come with sealant already applied.

Construction

  • Body: 45° swivel elbow
  • End 1: DOT push-in tube end
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal) male
  • Material: brass (C3600 / C3700 alloy, as the manufacturer states)

Ends and sealing

  • DOT push-in tube end: push-to-connect: the tube is pushed in, held by a gripping collet and sealed by an O-ring; SAE J2494.
  • NPTF (Dryseal): Dryseal taper pipe thread, cut so the crests and roots close up as the joint is tightened, so it seals on the thread; ASME B1.20.3.

Sizes

9 part numbers, 1/4" to 3/4" tube. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists the size on each end for every one.

  • End 1: DOT push-in tube end, 1/4" to 3/4"
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal), 1/8" to 1/2" (1/8-27 to 1/2-14)

Pressure and service

The manufacturer rates these fittings for compressed air only, no other gas or liquid, up to 150 psi, from −40 °F to +200 °F (−40 °C to +93 °C).

How to order

Quote the Indus part number from the size table. If you only have the fitting, send the size and thread type on each end, and Indus engineering will confirm the part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

products.title: Brass NPTF Male × NPTF Female Hex Bushing
products.focusKeyword: brass nptf bushing
products.descriptionShort: Brass NPTF Male × NPTF Female Hex Bushing. 20 part numbers, 1/4" to 2-1/2"; the size table gives the size on each end for every Indus part number.
products.descriptionLong:
The Brass NPTF Male × NPTF Female Hex Bushing is a bushing, in brass. Its ends are NPTF (Dryseal) male and NPTF (Dryseal) female. NPTF Dryseal pipe fittings seal on the thread itself and also mate with standard NPT threads, for air, water, fuel and low-pressure oil lines.

Construction

  • Body: bushing
  • End 1: NPTF (Dryseal) male
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal) female
  • Material: brass

Ends and sealing

  • NPTF (Dryseal): Dryseal taper pipe thread, cut so the crests and roots close up as the joint is tightened, so it seals on the thread; ASME B1.20.3.

Sizes

20 part numbers, 1/4" to 2-1/2". The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists the size on each end for every one.

  • End 1: NPTF (Dryseal), 1/4" to 2-1/2" (1/4-18 to 2-1/2-8)
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal), 1/8" to 1-1/2" (1/8-27 to 1-1/2-11.5)

Pressure and service

The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for this family. Tell us the medium, working pressure and temperature, and we will confirm the fitting before you order.

Carbon-steel version

The same configuration in zinc-plated carbon steel: Male Female Connector m NPT X f NPT.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number from the size table. If you only have the fitting, send the size and thread type on each end, and Indus engineering will confirm the part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

The Brass Push-Lock Hose Barb × NPTF Male is a straight hose barb, in CA360 brass (C36000 free-machining brass). Its ends are push-lock hose barb and NPTF (Dryseal) male. Construction

products.title: Brass SAE 45° Flare Male × NPTF Female 90° Elbow
products.focusKeyword: brass sae 45 flare male to nptf female 90 elbow
products.descriptionShort: Brass SAE 45° Flare Male × NPTF Female 90° Elbow, in CA360 brass. 12 part numbers, 3/16" to 3/4"; the size table gives the size on each end for every Indus part number.
products.descriptionLong:
The Brass SAE 45° Flare Male × NPTF Female 90° Elbow is a 90° elbow, in CA360 brass (C36000 free-machining brass). Its ends are SAE 45° flare male and NPTF (Dryseal) female. SAE 45° flare fittings carry a 45° flare on the male and a 45° cone seat in the female; the manufacturer recommends them for low- and medium-pressure lines.

Construction

  • Body: 90° elbow
  • End 1: SAE 45° flare male
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal) female
  • Material: CA360 brass (C36000 free-machining brass)

Ends and sealing

  • SAE 45° flare: 45° flare on the male seating in the 45° cone of the female, metal to metal; SAE J512.
  • NPTF (Dryseal): Dryseal taper pipe thread, cut so the crests and roots close up as the joint is tightened, so it seals on the thread; ASME B1.20.3.

Sizes

12 part numbers, 3/16" to 3/4". The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists the size on each end for every one.

  • End 1: SAE 45° flare, 3/16" to 3/4"
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal), 1/8" to 3/4" (1/8-27 to 3/4-14)

Pressure and service

The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for this family. Tell us the medium, working pressure and temperature, and we will confirm the fitting before you order.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number from the size table. If you only have the fitting, send the size and thread type on each end, and Indus engineering will confirm the part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.
